projects.issuer: UNICEF Papua New Guinea（牵头单位：国家教育部课程发展司 NDoE-CDD）
projects.projectName: Procurement of Grade 1 and Grade 2 Mathematics Textbooks and Teacher Manuals for Junior Primary Schools in Papua New Guinea

projectType.zh: 教材/教师手册印刷（含版面更新、包装、运输）
projectType.en: Textbook / teacher manual printing (incl. layout update, packing, shipping)

summary.zh: G1、G2数学学生用书及教师手册的印刷、版面更新、按校包装和海运，送至莱城港和莫尔兹比港，覆盖9个省、3,837所学校。
summary.en: Printing, layout update, school-level packing and sea freight of G1/G2 mathematics textbooks and teacher manuals to Lae and Port Moresby ports; 9 provinces, 3,837 schools.

quantity.zh: 学生用书：G1、G2各189,719本；教师手册：G1、G2各4,873本（附件1及ToR 3.2）。注意：ToR 5.1规格表数量较少（173,848 / 159,626 / 3,588 / 3,622），需向UNICEF澄清。
quantity.en: Student textbooks: 189,719 each for G1 and G2; teacher manuals: 4,873 each (Annex 1 and ToR 3.2). Note: the ToR 5.1 spec table shows lower figures (173,848 / 159,626 / 3,588 / 3,622) — to be clarified with UNICEF.

specs.zh: A4竖版；封面4页、250gsm、4C+4C；内页180/340/232/396页（G1书/G1手册/G2书/G2手册），内页只给出厚度0.087mm，未给克重；PUR胶装。
specs.en: A4 portrait; 4pp cover, 250gsm, 4C+4C; inside 180/340/232/396 pp (G1 book / G1 manual / G2 book / G2 manual), inside paper given only as 0.087mm thickness (no gsm); PUR perfect binding.

projects.fundingSource: GPE（系统转型拨款 STG），UNICEF为授权代理 / GPE (System Transformation Grant), UNICEF as grant agent
projects.currency: PGK；国际投标人用USD / PGK; USD for international bidders
projects.deliveryTerms: DAP (Incoterms 2020)（附件4按FCA报价，两者冲突，需澄清）
projects.deliveryLocation: 莱城港（8个省）；莫尔兹比港Motukea（中央省）/ Lae Port (8 provinces); Port Moresby Motukea (Central)

deliveryLeadTime.zh: 样品批准4–6周 + 印装10–12周 + 运输8–10周，合计约22–28周，未给最终交货日期
deliveryLeadTime.en: Sample approval 4–6 wks + printing 10–12 wks + shipping 8–10 wks = ~22–28 wks; no firm delivery date given

paymentTerms.zh: 10%印前文件批准后；40%印装完成后；50%到港并清关后；验收后30天内付款（与GTC 3.2“交货后开票”冲突）
paymentTerms.en: 10% on print-ready approval; 40% on printing & packing complete; 50% on delivery and customs clearance; paid within 30 days of acceptance (conflicts with GTC 3.2 'invoice after delivery')

customsResponsibility.zh: DAP下通常由买方进口清关，但ToR要求“清关完成”才付最后50%并要求提前一个月提供单证，责任不清，需澄清
customsResponsibility.en: Under DAP the buyer normally clears import, yet ToR ties the final 50% to customs clearance and requires documents a month ahead — unclear, to be clarified

bidMethod.zh: 仅限邮件提交至 png-bids@unicef.org；技术标和价格标分开发送，价格标设密码；每封小于25MB；不得抄送；不接受云盘链接。11月13日前确认参标意向。
bidMethod.en: Email only to png-bids@unicef.org; technical and price proposals separate, price file password-protected; <25MB per email; no CC; no cloud links. Confirm intent to bid by 13 Nov 2026.

registrationRequired.en: UNGM vendor number required on the bid form

bondRequirement.zh: 未要求投标保函；预付款超过总价20%或1万美元需银行保函
bondRequirement.en: No bid bond; bank guarantee required if advance payment exceeds 20% of price or USD 10,000

sampleRequired.zh: 资格要求提供类似教育印刷品样品，但仅邮件投标，提交方式未说明
sampleRequired.en: Samples of similar printed educational materials required, but submission is email-only; method unspecified

qualifications.zh: 合法注册并有税务合规文件；至少3年大规模教材印刷经验；近3年同类项目参考；具备产能与设备（评分另看近5年经验）
qualifications.en: Registered business with tax compliance documents; ≥3 years large-scale textbook printing; references from last 3 years; capacity & equipment (scoring looks at last 5 years)

intlSuppliersAllowed.zh: 允许，国际投标人以美元报价
intlSuppliersAllowed.en: Yes — international bidders quote in USD

projects.keyContact: Michelle Elizabeth Kopon (mkopon@unicef.org) — 仅供咨询，不用于提交报价 / enquiries only, not for submissions

openQuestions.zh: 1) 规格表与附件1数量不一致，G2数量疑似复制G1；2) FCA与DAP冲突，清关责任不清；3) 附件4缺版面更新、样书、说明卡片、缓冲库存、保险报价行，总价公式未乘集装箱数；4) 付款节点与GTC冲突；5) 违约金费率、保险要求（产品责任险含召回）；6) 可否只投一个Kit。详见《招标文件审阅》文档。
openQuestions.en: 1) Spec table vs Annex 1 quantity mismatch, G2 looks copied from G1; 2) FCA vs DAP conflict, customs responsibility unclear; 3) Annex 4 lacks lines for layout update, mock-ups, instruction cards, buffer stock, insurance; total formula ignores container count; 4) payment milestones conflict with GTC; 5) liquidated damages rate, insurance (product liability incl. recall); 6) can one Kit be bid alone. See the tender review document.

nextAction.zh: 11月13日前发送参标意向邮件；确认UNGM编号；向png-bids@unicef.org发送澄清问题；请UNICEF换方式提供Google Drive艺术稿（大陆无法访问）。
nextAction.en: Send intent-to-bid email by 13 Nov; confirm UNGM number; send clarification questions to png-bids@unicef.org; ask UNICEF for an alternative to the Google Drive artwork link (not reachable from mainland China).
